title: Grilled Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A classic Malaysian street food dish featuring marinated chicken grilled to perfection and served with a spicy peanut sauce.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, lemongrass, ginger, garlic, and chili peppers. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the blended mixture, peanut oil, and kecap manis. Add the chicken and mix until coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers.
Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, prepare the peanut sauce by heating the peanut butter and kecap manis in a small saucepan over low heat.
Stir in the chopped peanuts and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Serve the grilled chicken with peanut sauce and steamed vegetables, if desired.
